name: Muskiz (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Muskiz (a rose and two wolves on blue within a laurel wreath).
history: Municipal flag of Muskiz; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Muskiz arms — rose and wolves within a laurel wreath
